_meta.title: 02 현재 사진 · 같은 사람의 현재 모습

inputs.prompt: Replace the blank canvas in <image1> with ONE photorealistic vertical 9:16 photograph of a person meeting their younger self. <image2> is the PAST reference, placed on the LEFT. <image3> is the PRESENT reference, placed on the RIGHT. Render exactly two people, one version from each reference. Preserve each version independently: visible age, face shape, eyes and brows, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, body proportions and expression. Do not average their faces, swap identities, turn both into children, or make both the same age. Each person retains their OWN clothing, headwear and accessories from their OWN reference. Do not transfer clothes or headwear between people or invent a uniform. Preserve headwear fit and direction. If a reference is a portrait, infer unseen body and clothing conservatively from its visible neckline, fabric and colors; do not invent elaborate unseen details. Create a warm reunion portrait with the two versions close together. If the younger version is a child, the present-day version kneels or sits at a comfortable height beside them. Otherwise both stand or sit naturally side by side. The present-day version rests one relaxed hand lightly on the younger version’s outer shoulder. Keep the hand away from faces. Both faces are initially near frontal and clearly visible, with soft natural smiles. Use a medium-wide composition showing both heads, shoulders, hands and at least their knees; leave clear space around the two heads and at both sides so a slight head turn stays in frame. Match a single camera perspective, plausible age-relative scale, light direction and contact shadows. Use the setting visible in the PAST photo as the coherent background, excluding bystanders. If no setting is visible, use a simple softly blurred daylight outdoor background. Ignore cutout transparency, borders and studio backdrops in the PRESENT photo. The people must occupy the same physical space, not pasted panels. Natural skin texture and hands, nostalgic family-photo atmosphere. No additional people, split screen, collage, before/after divider, age labels, captions, speech bubbles, subtitles, watermark or extra limbs. Render one opaque RGB scene.
